plan.horizonNote: Lebbi ɗii ina njuɓɓina hitaande kala sabu ko hitaande tippudi, wonaa teskagol. Huutoro duuɓi garooji ɗii ngam yuɓɓinde aawdi, leydi e golle.

rotation.title: Sifaade rogere
rotation.sub: Rotaasiyoŋ ko yamiroore nde njiyloto-ɗaa e nder yontaaji. Waylu gese ɗee, ƴeewaa ko kewata e leydi ndii.
rotation.compareSub: Peeje ɗiɗi ɗee kala ina kuutoroo weeyo, leydi e ko ɓuri teeŋtude. Ko doggol ndema tan waylata.
rotation.winner: Ɓuri moƴƴude ko e priorités mon

rotation.note.short: Ɓeydu heen sahaa goɗɗo ngam ƴeewde no rogere mahirta.
rotation.note.legumeFirst: Lekki ko adii cereeli ina ñammina ndema garoowo — ina acca azot e nder leydi.
rotation.note.legume: {crop} ko leɗɗe. Ina waɗa azot e nder leydi.
rotation.note.noLegume: Alaa lekki ɗoo, ko ɗuum waɗi leydi ina rokka ko ɓuri ko heɓata caggal.
rotation.note.repeat: Gese ɗiɗi ummoriiɗe e galle gooto e nder laylaytol ina njaltina ñamri ngootiri.
rotation.note.variety: Jillondirde e galleeji ndema e luggiɗde ɗaɗi ina addana leydi ndi moƴƴude.
rotation.note.soil: Won e ɗeen gese njiɗaa leydi {soil}.
rotation.note.cover: Aawdi juutndi ina jokki e ɓuuɓnude leydi haa e lebbi yoorɗi.
rotation.why.title: Ko waɗi rogereeji ina ndeena leydi
rotation.why.1: Gese ceertuɗe ina ƴetta ñamri ceertundi. Aawde galle gooto laabi keewɗi ina ɓuuɓna leydi.
rotation.why.2: Njuumri leydi e njuumri ko leɗɗe. Ɓe ngollodoo e bakteriiji e dow ɗaɗi maɓɓe ngam waɗtude azot caggal.
rotation.why.3: Daɗi luggiɗɗi (millet, sorgo, maniyyu) ina ɓuuɓna leydi tiiɗndi ; ɗaɗi luggiɗɗi ina kuutoroo laral dow ngal.
rotation.why.4: Waɗde leydi ina ɓuuɓna e nder lebbi yoorɗi ina leeltina ɓuuɓri, ina jogoo ndiyam e nder leydi.
rotation.disclaimer: Ardorde hoyre mahnde e galleeji ndema, leydi ndi cifoto-ɗaa e toɓo nokku — wonaa jarribo leydi. Naamndo ekstensiyoŋ maa hade maa waylude rogere.
rotation.ctaSub: Ƴeewee no njuɓɓudi gese mon ndeenirta leydi e nder yontaaji keewɗi.
rotation.note.builds: E nder peeje ɗee fof, azot ina heewi hootde e nder leydi, ɓuri yaltude.
weather.shift: Ɗee ko hakkundeeje cakkitiiɗe, wonaa teskagol. Toɓo e nguleeki ina mbayloo hitaande e hitaande, ko ɗum waɗi ƴeewto-ɗaa sahaa garoowo hade maa aawde.
catalogue.title: Gese e ɓiɓɓe leɗɗe ndema ɗoo
catalogue.sub: Dowlaaji weeyo NASA POWER ina ngoodi. En ndarnii gese tan so tawii ko hoolkisaa ko ndiyam e nguleeki keertiiɗi e gese ina ngoodi.
catalogue.annualSub: Aawde e dañde e nder yontere wootere. Ko ɗeen ngoni geɗe ɗe peeje lewru kaalata.
catalogue.orchardSub: Ɗee ina ƴetta duuɓi ngam tabitinde, ɗum noon ɗe ngonaa e peeje aawdi lewru kala walla e rogere.
catalogue.note: Fotooje e nate laylaytol ina limtaa e CREDITS.md. Inɗe ganndal ummorii ko e catal ndema renndinde ; inɗe ɗemɗe nokkuuje ina ɓeydee e haalooɓe ɗemngal neeniwal.

error.geo_unavailable: Nokku maa waawaa anndeede. Ƴeewto so tawii sarwisaaji nokkuuji ɗii ina kuutoree, walla suɓo diiwaan les oo.
